settings.markdown:
## How to join
1. Join our Discord and say hello.
2. Tell us your RuneScape name.
3. Someone from the team invites you in game.

Once you're in, sign in here to link your name and get your own account page.

items.a: Big enough that someone's always online, small enough that people know your name.
